{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the premises
print("Shape of data:", df.shape)
print("Unique patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())
print("Value counts for 'arm':")
print(df['arm'].value_counts())
print("Value counts for 'responded':")
print(df['responded'].value_counts())
print("Max sample_seq per patient:")
print(df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts())"}
